title.es: PD de vida completa de Kaplan-Meier
Hazard en tiempo discreto con covariables macro

data_status.freddie_mac_reason: Freddie Mac: the owner's account is missing; the SBA twin is published

notice.en: Small-business loans, not mortgages: the SBA 7(a) loans are the public twin of the mortgage case. Freddie Mac's data is not used (the owner's account is missing). Default is a charge-off; the file has no delinquency history, no balance and no recovery after charge-off.
notice.es: Préstamos a pequeñas empresas, no hipotecas: los préstamos SBA 7(a) son el gemelo público del caso hipotecario. No se usan los datos de Freddie Mac (falta la cuenta del propietario). El incumplimiento es un castigo; el archivo no tiene historia de mora, saldo ni recuperaciones tras el castigo.

label.es: Adverso (punto medio de las formas Fed, propio de Contraste)

tests.h0: Stage 2 accounts default at the same rate as Stage 1 accounts (the SICR flag carries no information)
tests.alternative: Stage 2 defaults more often than Stage 1
tests.reference: EBA (2023), IFRS 9 implementation by EU institutions, 2023 Monitoring report, EBA/Rep/2023/36, doi:10.2853/269836, paras 94 to 99 and Figure 42; BCBS (2015), Guidance on credit risk and accounting for expected credit losses (d350), A38; dossier 02 I.2

extras.product_note: the file has no stage between reporting dates: months in Stage 2 are the months to default of an account in Stage 2 at the reporting date (an upper bound); a default of a Stage 1 account is counted as a direct move to Stage 3; no delinquency data, so no backstop-only share

tests.h0: the SICR threshold does not loosen in the periods in which conditions worsen
tests.alternative: the multiplier rises as the condition index rises
tests.reference: EBA (2023), IFRS 9 implementation by EU institutions, 2023 Monitoring report, EBA/Rep/2023/36, doi:10.2853/269836, paras 29 to 33; EBA (2021), IFRS 9 implementation by EU institutions, Monitoring report, EBA/Rep/2021/35, doi:10.2853/631076

tests.h0: the observed stage transitions are drawn from the predicted transition matrix
tests.alternative: the observed transitions differ from the predicted matrix
tests.reference: EBA (2023), IFRS 9 implementation by EU institutions, 2023 Monitoring report, EBA/Rep/2023/36, doi:10.2853/269836, para 97; Anderson and Goodman (1957), doi:10.1214/aoms/1177707039, equation (3.1)

tests.h0: the discounted realised losses within the horizon equal the model ECL for the same accounts
tests.alternative: realised losses differ from the ECL (R_H differs from 1)
tests.reference: IFRS 9 B5.5.52; EBA (2023), IFRS 9 implementation by EU institutions, 2023 Monitoring report, EBA/Rep/2023/36, doi:10.2853/269836, paras 100 to 104

tests.h0: the probability-weighted ECL equals the ECL at the probability-weighted mean path (a linear ECL)
tests.alternative: the weighted ECL exceeds the ECL at the mean path (convex ECL)
tests.reference: BCBS (2015), Guidance on credit risk and accounting for expected credit losses (d350), para 36(a); GPPC (2016), The implementation of IFRS 9 impairment requirements by banks, 2016-06-17, 2.8.1.2; IFRS 9 5.5.17(a), B5.5.42
tests.notes: the 100 per cent single-scenario ECLs in extras are sensitivities, never the IFRS 9 measure (5.5.17(a), B5.5.42)

extras.note: the 100 per cent single-scenario ECLs are sensitivities, never the IFRS 9 measure (5.5.17(a), B5.5.42)

tests.h0: the weighted PD equals the PD at the weighted mean factor (a linear PD in the systematic factor)
tests.alternative: the weighted PD exceeds the PD at the mean factor
tests.reference: dossier 02 B.4 and C.1 (BCBS 2005 explanatory note; Vasicek 2002; Gordy 2003, doi:10.1016/S1042-9573(03)00040-8)

tests.h0: overlays are a small, attributed, directionally consistent part of the allowance
tests.alternative: overlays are large or move against the direction of the scenarios
tests.reference: ECB Banking Supervision (2024), IFRS 9 overlays and model improvements for novel risks, doi:10.2866/034127; ECB letter SSM-2020-0744 (2020-12-04); BCBS (2015), Guidance on credit risk and accounting for expected credit losses (d350), paras 50 and 51

tests.h0: opening plus movements equals closing, by stage, and the waterfall opens into the stage tables
tests.alternative: an identity of the reconciliation does not close
tests.reference: IFRS 7 35H and 35I; dossier 02 I.1 items 9 and 10 and I.2

title.en: The lifetime PD of the hazard rung misses the observed cumulative default by up to 19.4 points (red)
title.es: La PD de vida completa del hazard se aparta del incumplimiento acumulado observado hasta 19.4 puntos (red)

title.en: The Stage 2 flag separates defaults from performing loans: amber (metric 2)
title.es: La marca de Etapa 2 separa los incumplimientos de los préstamos sanos: amber (métrica 2)

title.en: The 12-month ECL against the losses realised after the date: red (metric 0.0713)
title.es: La PCE a 12 meses frente a las pérdidas realizadas después de la fecha: red (métrica 0.0713)

title.en: The predicted stage migration against the observed one: red (p 0)
title.es: La migración de etapas prevista frente a la observada: red (p 0)

title.en: The severely adverse scenario gives a lower ECL than the baseline: the hazard's macro sensitivities have the wrong sign at this date
title.es: El escenario severamente adverso da una PCE menor que el base: las sensibilidades macro del hazard tienen el signo equivocado en esta fecha

title.en: The SBA file has no delinquency, forbearance or watch-list history: only the quantitative SICR test can move a loan to Stage 2, and Stage 3 holds no balance at a date
title.es: El archivo SBA no tiene historia de mora, refinanciación ni lista de vigilancia: solo la prueba cuantitativa de SICR puede pasar un préstamo a Etapa 2, y la Etapa 3 no tiene saldo en una fecha

title.en: LGD is a charge-off severity proxy with an upward bias (the file has no recovery after the charge-off) and the ECL is before the SBA guarantee
title.es: La PDI es un proxy de severidad del castigo con sesgo al alza (el archivo no tiene recuperaciones tras el castigo) y la PCE es antes de la garantía SBA

title.en: The balance is modelled (a level-payment annuity at the EIR; revolving lines at their approval): the file has no balance
title.es: El saldo es modelado (una anualidad de cuota nivelada a la TIE; líneas rotativas a su monto aprobado): el archivo no tiene saldo

title.en: Prepayment is treated as censoring: the lifetime PD is the cause-specific default hazard and carries no prepayment attrition
title.es: El prepago se trata como censura: la PD de vida completa es el hazard de incumplimiento por causa y no incluye atrición por prepago

title.en: 49,856 accounts with less than 33 months of contractual life left are outside the lifetime backtest
title.es: 49,856 cuentas con menos de 33 meses de vida contractual quedan fuera del backtest de vida completa
